Title: Self-Service Troubleshooting for App Service Web Apps Customers

Body.Content:
The Azure App Service team cares deeply about its customers! The team decided to ship some cool customer-facing supportability features to go along with Azure Functions and App Service Certificates. Introducing the self-help Troubleshoot blade for Web Apps customers. You can access the blade from the SUPPORT + TROUBLESHOOTING section of the Web Apps Settings blade. Initially, the team is targeting top supportability issues, like these:
  1. My app is returning HTTP 5xx errors.
  2. My app is performing slowly.
